meta.name: defi-protocol-templates
meta.description: Implement DeFi protocols with production-ready templates for staking, AMMs, governance, and flash loans. Use when building decentralized finance applications or smart contract protocols.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在开发区块链应用，需要搭建 DeFi 协议
copy.tagline_en: Use production-ready templates to build DeFi protocols

howto.what: 需要时帮你产出 DeFi 协议合约模板：含质押奖励（stake/withdraw/getReward）与 AMM（加撤流动性、swap）的 Solidity 代码；治理代币、闪贷等更多模板见 references/details.md。
howto.when: 当你在构建 DeFi 应用或智能合约协议时触发，例如做质押奖励平台、AMM 协议、治理代币系统等。

say.text: 帮我写一个带奖励分配的质押合约模板
say.note: 返回 Solidity 质押奖励合约代码

say.text: 给我一个 AMM 的加流动性和 swap 实现
say.note: 返回 SimpleAMM 合约模板

howto.what_en: Generates Solidity contract templates for DeFi protocols: staking with reward distribution (stake/withdraw/getReward) and an AMM with add/remove liquidity and swaps. Governance and flash loan templates live in references/details.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you build DeFi applications or smart contract protocols, such as staking reward platforms, AMM protocols, or governance token systems.

say_en.text: Write me a staking contract template with reward distribution
say_en.note: Returns a Solidity staking rewards contract

say_en.text: Give me an AMM with add liquidity and swap
Where are the flash loan and governance templates?
